title: Your First n8n AI Automation: Step-by-Step Playbook
tldr: Build a chat-triggered AI agent in n8n, test it, then publish it to run on its own.
You need an n8n account (cloud trial or self-hosted) and one chat-model API key.

tools.name: n8n
tools.note: Cloud free trial, or self-host the free Community Edition

tools.name: A chat model API key
tools.note: Create a key, keep it private, add it as an n8n credential

steps.title: Open n8n and create a workflow
steps.detail: Cloud trial or self-hosted Community Edition. Click Create Workflow and name it.

steps.title: Add the On chat message trigger
steps.detail: Click Add first step and choose On chat message (the Chat Trigger node).

steps.title: Add the AI Agent node
steps.detail: Click the plus after the trigger and add AI Agent.

steps.title: Connect a chat model
steps.detail: Under Chat Model add OpenAI Chat Model or a Google Gemini chat model.

steps.title: Create the credential
steps.detail: Open the credential dropdown, Create New Credential, paste your API key, save.

steps.title: Attach one tool
steps.detail: Click plus under Tool and add the Date and Time tool.

steps.title: Write the agent instructions
steps.detail: In the agent options give it a job, a tone and one rule it must never break.

steps.title: Test by hand
steps.detail: Click Execute Workflow or use the chat. Read each node output panel.

steps.title: Swap in a Schedule Trigger (optional)
steps.detail: Pick an interval or type a cron expression.

steps.title: Publish
steps.detail: Saving is not enough: publish so triggers and schedules run on their own.

snippets.label: Starter agent instructions
snippets.code:
You are an assistant for my small business.
Answer in two sentences.
If you do not know, say so.
Never invent prices or dates: use the tools.

snippets.label: Five test questions (run each one)
snippets.code:
What is the date three days from now?
Summarise this in one sentence: <paste text>
Write a polite two-line reply to: <paste email>
What should I do first today? (I have 3 tasks: <list>)
Explain n8n triggers to a beginner in two sentences.

snippets.label: Cron examples for the Schedule Trigger
snippets.code:
0 9 * * *      every day at 09:00
*/15 * * * *   every 15 minutes
0 8 * * 1-5   weekdays at 08:00

tips: Keep your first automation tiny: one trigger, one agent, one output.
Rename nodes so a stranger can read the workflow.
Change the question five times before you trust an agent.
Open n8n's template library and study the Build your first AI agent template.
mistakes: Skipping the credential: the model node fails with no key.
Testing forever on schedule: test by hand, publish when ready.
Pasting your API key into chats or screenshots.
Building five automations before one works end to end.
action_plan: Day 1: build the Chat Trigger + AI Agent from this guide.
Day 2: add the model credential and run five test questions.
Day 3: add the Date and Time tool and re-test.
Day 4: write your agent instructions and rerun the five questions.
Day 5: swap in the Schedule Trigger (daily, 09:00).
Day 6: publish and watch one production run.
Day 7: write down what saved you time and pick the next automation.
